story.text: 공원 벤치에 앉아 하늘을 올려다보니, 아침보다 구름이 부쩍 낮게 깔려 있었다. 바람도 한결 서늘해진 느낌이었다.
story.reading: gong-won ben-chi-e anj-a ha-neul-eul ol-lyeo-da-bo-ni, a-chim-bo-da gu-reum-i bu-jjeok nat-ge kkal-lyeo iss-eot-da. ba-ram-do han-gyeol seo-neul-hae-jin neu-kkim-i-eot-da.
story.en: Sitting on a park bench and looking up at the sky, the clouds hung noticeably lower than in the morning. The wind felt cooler too.

story.text: "오늘 날씨가 좀 변덕스럽네요." 규현이 휴대폰 화면을 들여다보며 중얼거렸다. "아침이랑 완전 딴판이에요."
story.reading: "o-neul nal-ssi-ga jom byeon-deok-seu-reop-ne-yo." gyu-hyeon-i hyu-dae-pon hwa-myeon-eul deul-yeo-da-bo-myeo jung-eol-geo-ryeot-da. "a-chim-i-rang wan-jeon ttan-pan-i-e-yo."
story.en: "The weather's a bit fickle today." Kyuhyun murmured, peering at his phone screen. "Completely different from this morning."

story.text: "기온이 다섯 도나 떨어졌대요." 그가 화면을 내 쪽으로 돌려 보여주며 말했다. "그러니까 그렇게 얇게 입고 나온 거, 후회 중이죠?"
story.reading: "gi-on-i da-seot do-na tteol-eo-jyeot-dae-yo." geu-ga hwa-myeon-eul nae jjok-eu-ro dol-lyeo bo-yeo-ju-myeo mal-haet-da. "geu-reo-ni-kka geu-reo-ke yalb-ge ip-go na-on geo, hu-hoe jung-i-jyo?"
story.en: "They say the temperature dropped five degrees." He turned the screen toward me. "So, regretting wearing something so thin, are you?"

story.text: 내가 저도 모르게 어깨를 움츠리자, 그는 눈치 빠르게 그걸 알아챘다. "거봐요, 쌀쌀하다니까. 그래서, 춥다고 순순히 말할 거예요, 말 거예요?"
story.reading: nae-ga jeo-do mo-reu-ge eo-kkae-reul um-cheu-ri-ja, geu-neun nun-chi ppa-reu-ge geu-geol al-a-chaet-da. "geo-bwa-yo, ssal-ssal-ha-da-ni-kka. geu-rae-seo, chub-da-go sun-sun-hi mal-hal geo-ye-yo, mal geo-ye-yo?"
story.en: As I unconsciously hunched my shoulders, he noticed right away. "See, I told you it's chilly. So — are you going to admit you're cold, or not?"

story.text: 그는 대답도 듣지 않고 가방에서 얇은 겉옷을 꺼내 내 어깨에 툭 걸쳐주었다. "됐죠? 이런 날은 겉옷 하나쯤 챙기는 게 기본이에요."
story.reading: geu-neun dae-dab-do deut-ji anh-go ga-bang-e-seo yalb-eun geot-ot-eul kkeon-nae nae eo-kkae-e tuk geol-chyeo-ju-eot-da. "dwaet-jyo? i-reon nal-eun geot-ot ha-na-jjeum chaeng-gi-neun ge gi-bon-i-e-yo."
story.en: Without waiting for an answer, he pulled a light jacket from his bag and draped it over my shoulders. "There. On a day like this, bringing a jacket is just basic."

story.text: 그때 후두둑, 굵은 빗방울이 하나둘 떨어지기 시작했다. 규현이 가방에서 태연하게 우산을 꺼내 폈다. "이럴 줄 알았어요." 그가 능청스럽게 웃었다.
story.reading: geu-ttae hu-du-duk, gulg-eun bit-bang-ul-i ha-na-dul tteol-eo-ji-gi si-jak-haet-da. gyu-hyeon-i ga-bang-e-seo tae-yeon-ha-ge u-san-eul kkeon-nae pyeot-da. "i-reol jul al-at-eo-yo." geu-ga neung-cheong-seu-reop-ge us-eot-da.
story.en: Just then, plip-plop, fat raindrops began to fall one by one. Kyuhyun casually pulled an umbrella from his bag and opened it. "Figured this might happen." He smirked, cool as ever.

story.text: 우산 하나 아래 나란히 붙어 서서 처마 밑으로 뛰어가는 동안, 그의 웃음소리가 빗소리 사이로 유쾌하게 섞여 들었다.
story.reading: u-san ha-na a-rae na-ran-hi but-eo seo-seo cheo-ma mit-eu-ro ttwi-eo-ga-neun dong-an, geu-ui us-eum-so-ri-ga bit-so-ri sa-i-ro yu-kwae-ha-ge seokk-yeo deul-eot-da.
story.en: Huddled together under one umbrella, running toward the eaves, his laughter mixed cheerfully into the sound of the rain.

words.example_en: The temperature dropped a lot today.
It's a bit chilly in the evening.
I brought a jacket with me.

sentences.en: It's a bit chilly, so bring a jacket.
It looks like it'll rain today.
